Example Pharma Inc.

SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE. Not a real FDA letter. Company and numbers are fictional.

MARCS-CMS 699001. FEI: 3009990001

Dear Mr. Sample:

The U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) inspected your drug manufacturing facility, Example Pharma Inc., from October 1 to October 10, 2024.

This warning letter summarizes significant violations of Current Good Manufacturing Practice (CGMP) regulations for finished pharmaceuticals. See 21 CFR parts 210 and 211.

During our inspection, our investigator observed specific violations including, but not limited to, the following.

1. Your firm failed to exercise appropriate controls over computer or related systems to assure that only authorized personnel institute changes in master production and control records or other records (21 CFR 211.68(b)).

Analysts in your quality control laboratory shared a single login to the chromatography data system. Audit trails for the HPLC system were not reviewed as part of batch release. Laboratory analysts had administrator privileges allowing them to delete data files.

Your response should include a comprehensive assessment of your audit trail review practices and user access controls.

2. Your firm failed to establish and follow appropriate written procedures that are designed to prevent microbiological contamination (21 CFR 211.113(b)).

The reconstituted solution was cloudy and your firm did not investigate. Media fills were performed on a shared equipment train.

3. Your firm failed to ensure that laboratory records included complete data derived from all tests necessary to assure compliance with established specifications and standards (21 CFR 211.194(a)).

Assay results were calculated in an Excel spreadsheet that had not been validated. The spreadsheet formulas were not locked.

Data Integrity Remediation

Your quality system does not adequately ensure the accuracy and integrity of data. We recommend that you engage a consultant.

Conclusion

The violations cited in this letter are not intended to be an all-inclusive list.
